in_marathi.name: Lavesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lavesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit 'Lav', meaning 'to play' and 'esh', meaning 'god'. This name signifies the god of love and passion. In Hindu mythology, Lavesh is a form of the god Krishna, known for his romantic exploits.
